title: Dog Night, 2019 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after twenty years: a sheet of stick-figure stickers on the drafting table, a sample from the aggregator, thirty of them, and the pup on the table eating them one by one while Wood pretends to stop him. He gets twenty-nine. The one that survives goes on the corkboard upside down.

panels.composition: The garage. A glossy sheet of thirty stick-figure stickers on the drafting table. The PUP on the table, one sticker on his nose. WOOD.

characters.pose: on the table, a sticker on his nose

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog on a drafting table with a glossy sticker stuck to its nose beside a sheet of stick-figure stickers while a thin man half-heartedly objects

panels.composition: The sheet, mostly bare. Twenty-nine gone.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a glossy sticker sheet on a table with twenty-nine empty spaces and one sticker left

panels.composition: The last sticker, transferred from the pup's nose to the corkboard, upside down, below the yearbook photo.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small dog pressing its nose to the bottom of a corkboard leaving a sticker stuck upside down beneath a small old photo

panels.composition: WOOD looking at it there. Leaving it.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man looking at an upside-down sticker on a corkboard and deciding to leave it

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The Stickers (Nov 2019) arrives on Dog Night's morning; the survivor on Wood's garage board, upside down (objects.md).
